title: What a month of posts looks like

media.alt: K&A Performance slide on a cream background: 12 posts. One month. Here's what each one is for. Below, a grid labeled Sample month: four weeks by Monday, Wednesday and Friday, each tile coded by its job. Week 1: behind the scenes, proof, tip. Week 2: proof, offer, tip. Week 3: behind the scenes, tip, offer. Week 4: proof, behind the scenes, offer.

A calendar titled Sample month: a local business, 3 posts a week on Facebook and Instagram. Week 1: Monday reel, behind the scenes, meet the team, one face at a time. Wednesday carousel, proof, a recent job, before and after. Friday tip post, one thing to check before you book anyone. Week 2: Monday reel, proof, a customer review in their own words. Wednesday carousel, offer, this month's offer, details up front. Friday tip post, the question we hear most, answered. Week 3: Monday reel, behind the scenes, one job start to finish. Wednesday carousel, tip, 3 signs it's time to call a pro. Friday carousel, offer, what's open next week and how to book. Week 4: Monday reel, proof, why a regular keeps coming back. Wednesday carousel, behind the scenes, what we changed this month and why. Friday carousel, offer, last week to book this month's offer.

Only 3 of the 12 ask for the sale. Every post has one job. Proof, 3 of 12: shows you deliver, reviews, before and afters, real customers. Tip, 3 of 12: answers what customers already ask, worth saving and sharing. Behind the scenes, 3 of 12: puts a face on the business, who does the work and how. Offer, 3 of 12: gives a clear next step, what to book, by when, and how.

How it works, steps 1 and 2. We plan the month: every post on one page, the day, the format, and what it's for. You approve the plan once: mark each post run, change, or drop; it's the only approval you give, and nothing is made until then. A plan sheet shows four sample posts with Run checked, and 8 more. Our own weekly plan opens with the same line: Mark each slot: run, change, or drop.

Step 3: We build and schedule. You approve the month's plan once. We take it from there. A, Brief: one page per post, what it's for, the hook, the slides or shots. B, Build: reels and carousels, captions, and a music track. C, Check: we check every finished post before it goes out. D, Schedule: queued on Facebook and Instagram for the month. This is how we run K&A's own Facebook and Instagram, every week.

Step 4: You get a short report. A monthly report card lists reach, how many people saw your posts; engagement, likes, comments, shares and saves; and clicks to your site, who went from a post to your website; each with a blank box for your number. Then: next month's plan starts from what the report shows.

Dark teal panel: Want this for your business? 3 free months for 3 Gainesville businesses. 3 posts a week on Facebook and Instagram. You approve the plan before anything is made. Call Alex, 904-210-1071, or message us on Facebook or Instagram. K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top.
